subject: Valence Health: Access conductor kickoff & SAML/SCIM handoff
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Kelley <tom.kelley@valencehealth.com>, Alice Ng <alice.ng@valencehealth.com>, procurement@valencehealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Valence Health: Access conductor kickoff & SAML/SCIM handoff

Hi Tom / Alice / Valence procurement team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference. I'm Hannah on the Customer Success team; Jordan (CS engineering lead) and Ben (solutions) are cc'd and will own the SSO/SCIM and network pieces. To keep momentum, attached is a short mutual action plan (valence-mam-v1.xlsx) and the initial SAML metadata we can exchange (valence-saml-metadata.xml).

Quick asks to unblock the first delivery window:
- Can you share the IdP metadata endpoint / metadata XML if you prefer we ingest it, or tell us whether you prefer we host our metadata?
- SCIM: please confirm the primary unique identifier you want us to map (email vs. externalId). If you have an existing attribute map, paste it or share a sample user.
- IP allowlist: provide the egress IPs or CIDR(s) you'll whitelist for Redwood-hosted callbacks (we can provide ours once you confirm host mode).
- Service accounts: we recommend service-account names scoped per team (guidelines attached). Please confirm any naming conventions.

Proposed sync: Tue 9 Mar, 11am PT — 30 min to walk through SAML/SCIM mapping and preflight items. If that works, we can send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Attachments: valence-mam-v1.xlsx (MAM), valence-saml-metadata.xml

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform

Hannah —

Appreciate the materials and clear asks. A few quick items from our side:

- We can host IdP metadata at https://idp.valencehealth.com/metadata.xml — attaching our current metadata.
- For SCIM, we currently use email as the canonical identifier; we can supply groups as a separate attribute. Does Redwood support group provisioning (enterprise groups -> roles)?
- IP allowlist: we need Redwood's egress IPs for callback URLs and webhook delivery.
- SOC 2 & security questionnaire: procurement asked if you can attach or link your SOC 2 report and the standard security questionnaire responses.

Procurement: please advise on PO / onboarding contracting cadence — we expect to have a standard SOW and PO in the next two weeks.

Tom

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Valence Health: Access conductor kickoff & SAML/SCIM handoff

Tom / Alice —

Thanks for the fast reply and the IdP endpoint. Short answers and next steps from our engineering side:

- Metadata: we'll fetch your metadata from https://idp.valencehealth.com/metadata.xml and return our SP metadata (attached as valence-saml-metadata.xml) for your IdP admin to ingest.
- SCIM & groups: Redwood supports SCIM 2.0 group provisioning. Recommended mapping (we can adjust on the call):
  - id -> externalId
  - userName -> email
  - displayName -> name
  - emails[type=work] -> primary email
  - groups -> redwood:roles (we will provide a sample mapping sheet in the MAM)
- Service accounts: attached guidelines (service-account-naming-guidelines.pdf). Our recommended pattern: redwood-sa-<project>-<env> (e.g., redwood-sa-valence-prod). We'll create an initial service account draft and share for your approval before we create keys.
- IP allowlists: For hosted callbacks and webhook egress, Redwood will use a small, static set of egress CIDRs — see below. Please confirm which of these you can add or whether you prefer we use mutual TLS.
  - 52.23.112.0/24
  - 52.24.77.0/24
  - 34.201.40.0/24

Security docs: SOC 2 link and completed questionnaire attached to this thread for procurement (we use an external gated portal; I'll upload and share a short access link in the meeting if needed).

Proposed schedule: Tue 9 Mar, 11am PT — we'll cover: metadata exchange, SCIM attribute map, service-account naming and key rotation plan, IP allowlist vs mTLS decision. If that time works, Hannah will send the calendar invite with a brief agenda.

Thanks — Jordan Blake
Customer Success Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
